# AI Fleet OPS

> One plane and one queue for multi-agent operations in production.

Operating manual for a multi-agent team. Public posts stay on hold until the owner gives a go.

## Pages

- [Hub](https://ops.0xray.dev/): one plane, one queue
- [Operating guides](https://ops.0xray.dev/guides/): category path and house guides
- [Map the agentic control plane](https://ops.0xray.dev/guides/control-plane/): orchestration, observability, and the control plane
- [What AI fleet ops means](https://ops.0xray.dev/guides/what-is-ai-fleet-ops/): roles, queue, review, and spend
- [Frameworks build agents; ops runs them](https://ops.0xray.dev/guides/framework-vs-ops/): ops checklist around build frameworks
- [Take your agent pilot to production](https://ops.0xray.dev/guides/pilot-to-production/): owner, review gate, audit, and budget
- [Govern agent spend and policy](https://ops.0xray.dev/guides/spend-governance/): token spend per agent and policy
- [Release gates for agents](https://ops.0xray.dev/guides/ship-gates/): review, PASS, and the receipt
- [Stand up an agent team](https://ops.0xray.dev/guides/stand-up/): keep the job after context loss
- [When not to post](https://ops.0xray.dev/guides/eng-vs-dist/): build lane versus public posts
- [Agent model spend](https://ops.0xray.dev/guides/compute-discipline/): spec first, one run, weekly hold line
- [Glossary](https://ops.0xray.dev/lexicon/): industry term first, our name second
